name: ping
description: Send ICMP echo requests to a host

options.name: -c
options.description: Stop after sending this many packets

options.name: -W
options.description: Seconds to wait for a reply

options.name: -w
options.description: Stop after this many seconds in total

options.name: -s
options.description: Number of data bytes to send

options.name: -t
options.description: Set the IP time to live

options.name: -I
options.description: Send from this interface or address

options.name: -n
options.description: Numeric output only, no name lookups

options.name: -D
options.description: Print a timestamp before each line
